checks.evidence: No test replays a week with PSI of about 0.15. The 'exactly 0.2' test covers the no-alert boundary, but it is a different input value, so it is not equivalent.

The test 'Alert is raised when weekly predicted-category PSI is greater than 0.2', step 3, raises an alert for PSI 0.25. It only says the alert shows a deviation from the baseline and does not say the alert states the measured PSI.
